source_state: Runtime files identified by source_sha256; base_revision alone does not identify uncommitted files.
scope: L40S final CuTe vs released arithmetic/schedules, precision-matched preceding schedules and default SDPA, B1/H16 contiguous BHSD, FP16/BF16 dense/causal. Resident GPU work through warmed CUDA graphs; forward retains autograd and joint includes all three gradients. Initial API dispatch, compilation and full-model costs excluded; CUDA-event spans can include host replay submission gaps.

protocol.ordering: Rotate all four backend orders each round.
protocol.reference: Full-length centered FP64 on identical rounded inputs, two-head chunks.
protocol.accuracy_gate: Independent output/dQ/dK/dV: pointwise atol=rtol .02 BF16 or .003 FP16; norm-relative error below 1% BF16 or 0.5% FP16; exact zero for zero reference.
protocol.kernel_verification: Driver CUDA-graph function identity/resources only in this process; activity profilers run in separate processes.
protocol.phase_note: Backward retains a forward graph. Separately timed medians need not sum to joint.

controls.released: All new architecture selectors and final kernels.precision_schedule disabled. Reconstructs 3e17149 computation through this compiler, not a byte-identical old binary.
controls.previous: Only L40S selector disabled; final shared precision retained.
controls.cute: Final L40S selectors and shared precision enabled.

separate_process_evidence.scope: Separate processes after canonical medians. These are representative code/activity/sustained/sanitizer checks, not additional canonical timing samples. Raw captures and exact private harnesses retained externally.

machine_code.scope: Uninstrumented driver-graph resources plus exact compiled PTX/ELF. No profiler initialization or timing claims.
